label: Břišní tanec s hudbou · 10 s (LTX)
desc: Deset sekund břišního tance v jednom kuse, s vygenerovanou orientální hudbou. Bez střihů, takže nic neškube — ale čím delší klip, tím víc se mění tvář.
desc_en: Ten seconds of belly dance in a single take, with generated middle-eastern music. No cuts, so nothing jerks — but the longer the clip, the more the face drifts.
style_tail: , static camera, natural room lighting, photorealistic, highly detailed
negative: worst quality, inconsistent motion, blurry, jittery, distorted

beats.prompt: she performs a belly dance in place: torso waves, hip shimmies and hip drops, arms flowing gracefully overhead, then a slow turn on the spot, ending facing the camera. Middle-eastern percussion music with a steady drum rhythm.
